verdict.rationale: Feitian's lineup clearly spans USB-A, USB-C, NFC, BLE and even Lightning interfaces across multiple models (BioPass K26, MultiPass, USB+NFC key), showing broad port/connectivity coverage. However, there is no explicit mention of keychain or nano/low-profile form factors in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit nano/low-profile form factor listing, keychain-style design mention, independent hands-on confirmation of physical size variants.
